integrity: The exact ball transform and large-order Bessel-zero asymptotics are credited to published literature. Numerical checks corroborate but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to invertible affine images of fixed Cartesian products of Euclidean balls and the first real Fourier zero.
The stability constant 2 is not claimed optimal; the exponent one-half is sharp.
The entropy limit requires a fixed number of blocks with positive limiting proportions.
No global extremality or independent certification is asserted; unindexed historical overlap remains possible.
title: Affine rigidity, quantitative stability, and entropic Fourier-zero loss for products of Euclidean balls
